messages:
anne_support: FYI — customer (Acme Corp) says invoice INV-7201 paid but PO# missing on delivered invoice PDF. They need PO on file for reconciliation. Ticket #4352.
kevin_billing: Do we have the original payment id or invoice metadata?
anne_support: Payment id: pay_3K9xY. Customer says they included PO in the checkout form (field 'purchase_order'), but PDF shows blank. They attached screenshots.
sarah_engineer: Likely two paths: either PO never flowed into invoice metadata, or the invoice PDF template omitted metadata during render. Can you paste the raw invoice JSON from the API?
anne_support: Pasting sanitized invoice JSON below (removed PII):
```
{
  "id": "inv_7201",
  "status": "paid",
  "amount": 12500,
  "metadata": {
    "customer_reference": "ACME-2026"
  },
  "lines": [...]
}
```
kevin_billing: Looks like purchase_order is not present in metadata. Did the checkout call send it? We should check the payment request logs.
anne_support: I pulled the API gateway logs — checkout POST /v1/charges shows body included purchase_order: "PO-9987". Here's the request body excerpt: 
```
{
  "amount": 12500,
  "currency": "usd",
  "metadata": {"purchase_order":"PO-9987", "origin":"self-serve"}
}
```
sarah_engineer: Hmm — if the charge had metadata but invoice doesn't, it implies our invoice creation path didn't copy metadata (edge case when we auto-invoice from subscription vs one-off). Which billing flow was used?
anne_support: Customer used one-off payment flow via hosted checkout (no subscription).
kevin_billing: That should map metadata normally. Two theories: (1) metadata stripped during PDF render because template references invoice.metadata.purchase_order but value missing; (2) webhook consumer that writes PDFs receives a different invoice object. We need repro.
jordan_csm: Customer is pushing for fast resolution — they can't post the invoice without PO. Could we issue a correction/credit and rebill with PO on new invoice? They prefer to keep the same paid amount but have a corrected invoice.
sarah_engineer: We can't edit a paid invoice to add missing PO (audit rules). Standard flow: create a credit (negative invoice) for the original, then create a new invoice with the same line items + metadata.purchase_order set to PO-9987, then mark it paid (rebill). Steps below.
kevin_billing: Outline please — I can do the billing ops if you confirm commands.
sarah_engineer: Steps (short):
1) Create credit note referencing inv_7201 (API: POST /v1/credits with { invoice_id: "inv_7201", reason: "metadata_correction", amount: 12500 }).
2) Create new invoice draft for customer with identical lines and metadata.purchase_order = "PO-9987".
3) Send invoice or directly record payment to mark it paid (we can record offline payment if they already paid).
4) Attach internal note linking credit to new invoice.

Example API payloads:
```
# create credit (billing ops)
POST /v1/credits
{
  "invoice_id": "inv_7201",
  "amount": 12500,
  "reason": "po_missing_on_original",
  "metadata": {"operator":"kevin_billing","linked_ticket":"4352"}
}

# create new invoice
POST /v1/invoices
{
  "customer_id": "cus_ACME",
  "lines": [... identical lines ...],
  "metadata": {"purchase_order":"PO-9987", "original_invoice":"inv_7201"}
}

# record payment (if customer already paid)
POST /v1/invoices/inv_7201_correction/payments
{
  "amount": 12500,
  "method": "manual",
  "reference": "manual-rebill-4352",
  "metadata": {"operator":"kevin_billing"}
}
```
kevin_billing: Got it. Any VAT/tax caveats? The customer is EU-based and the original invoice had VAT applied. If we issue a credit and a new invoice with the same tax lines, totals should match, but need to ensure tax ids (VAT reg number) are present on the new invoice PDF.
anne_support: Customer provided VAT ID in the ticket: EU-ACME-111. It was present in customer profile, but PDF still missing PO — odd.
sarah_engineer: When creating the new invoice include customer.vat_id in billing details and set invoice.locale to EU for correct VAT rendering. Also ensure invoice.metadata.purchase_order is used by the PDF generator. I'll push a quick check to the PDF service to include invoice.metadata.* into context.
billing-bot: AUTO: created audit event for ticket 4352 at 1769998950. (event_id: ev_92xf)
kevin_billing: I'll prepare the credit and new invoice now — will annotate operator metadata. ETA ~20m.
jordan_csm: I'll message the customer with the expected timeline and request confirmation that PO is exactly "PO-9987" and they accept corrected invoice approach.
anne_support: Thanks — after rebill I'll attach both PDFs (credit note and corrected invoice) to the ticket. Please add step-by-step notes so we can reuse as KB. :memo: 
sarah_engineer: After ops completes, I'll run a quick internal regression: simulate checkout create -> invoice render for one-off payments to confirm metadata flows through. If we find a bug, we'll patch template or mapping.
kevin_billing: Credit created ev: cr_88a1, new invoice id inv_7201_v2 created and marked paid. I attached PDFs in ticket.
anne_support: Customer confirmed receipt and PO shows on corrected PDF. Closing loop with CSM. :white_check_mark: 
jordan_csm: Customer happy, asked for KB link once we document it. Thanks team. :tada:
